_comment: Copy this to bridge.config.json and fill it in. Keep that file readable only by the account that runs the bridge: it holds the analyzer's key.
_mode: folder watches a directory the analyzer writes to; tcp listens for the analyzer to connect
_folderMode: Point watchDir at the folder the analyzer or its software saves results into. sent/, failed/ and queue/ are created inside it.
_tcpMode: Used when mode is tcp. Set the analyzer to send to this machine's address on this port. watchDir is still used to hold anything that could not be delivered.
